title: Widget Singles Markdown editor & page availability
content:
JeffersonWM Singles and the widget dashboard at jeffersonwm.com/account/widget received a rich text upgrade, page availability controls, and system URL protections.

Key additions:

  • Feed-Style Markdown Editor: Replaced the simple textarea with a dual Write / Preview tabbed editor and formatting toolbar (Headings, Bold, Italic, Unordered List, Ordered List, Quote, Code, and Link). Content preview renders instantly within the card.
  • Public Markdown Typography: Single pages at /<slug>/ now render formatted Markdown HTML with dedicated typography for headings, lists, blockquotes, code, and external links styled to match JeffersonWM.
  • Active / Inactive Availability: Added page availability toggles across the database, REST API, static fallbacks, and local storage, allowing pages to be removed from public view without deletion.
  • Silent 404 Pre-Check: The single page shell hides content until active status is confirmed, redirecting inactive or missing slugs to /404.html without any visual flash.
  • Protected System URLs: Created a centralized reserved-urls.txt registry ensuring custom single-page slugs cannot collide with system routes or existing applications.
  • Accordion Organization & Autosave: Streamlined card lists into accordion cards with automatic saving on field blur and status click.
  • Scallions Home Link: Added Scallions to the JeffersonWM home navigation directory.
